mintAuthority.summary: BRZ Ethereum owner and masterMinter are both a 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe (0xaf24/0x2c64, proxy to singleton 0xd9db). Proxy admin (0x478e) is also owned by the same Safe. Non-Ethereum chain owners are issuer-context EOAs or 2-of-3 Safes. Solana mint authority is a system-program wallet. All controls corroborate Transfero centralized issuance.

controls.label: BRZ Ethereum owner — 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294823: owner() on BRZ ETH (0x01d33fd36ec67c6ada32cf36b31e88ee190b1839) returned 0xaf24edebf7fdaed86d839be018647ba6279b9d7a. Storage of 0xaf24: slot0=GnosisSafe singleton 0xd9db, slot3=ownerCount 3, slot4=threshold 2, slot5=nonce 5. Owners read from linked list at mapping slot 2: 0x567a (EOA), 0x8c5f (EOA), 0x2455 (EOA). Modules: sentinel points to 0x1 (none-detected). masterMinter() (0x2c64) is a matching 2-of-3 Safe (ownerCount=3, threshold=2, nonce=15). ProxyAdmin 0x478e owner() = 0xaf24 (same Safe).

controls.evidence: Solana getAccountInfo on SPL mint FtgGSFADXBtroxq8VCausXRr2of47QBf5AS1NtZCu4GD: mint_authority = ACvei6oQMQSP2GqGnTmPrrcfgwPWEcVkoospHtdYhk7D (system-program account, Transfero issuer wallet). freeze_authority = None.

review.evidence: Ethereum at block 25294823: owner() = 0xaf24 (2-of-3 GnosisSafe proxy, masterCopy=0xd9db GnosisSafe 1.3.0 singleton). Safe storage: ownerCount=3, threshold=2, nonce=5. Three EOA owners confirmed via linked-list traversal. Modules sentinel = 0x1 (no modules). masterMinter 0x2c64 is an identical 2-of-3 Safe (nonce=15). ProxyAdmin 0x478e owned by same Safe. BSC owner is EOA 0x01455c. Solana mint authority ACvei6 is a system-program wallet. Polygon and Base owners are also 2-of-3 Safes (threshold=2, ownerCount=3). BRZ is issued by Transfero Swiss AG (Zug); the only dated third-party reserve review located is a ~2020 law-firm report, and current transparency relies on Parsiq blockchain analytics rather than a recurring named accounting-firm attestation, so reconciliation is unknown. Transfero Swiss AG's Swiss oversight is VQF membership, a FINMA-recognised AML self-regulatory organisation that is explicitly not prudential supervision, and no FINMA banking/EMI licence for the BRZ issuer was found, so supervision is none.
